target: bench.sh remove — the review stage's own TEST-PLAN.md is not 'user work'
cmd: source "$FIXTURES/bench-repo.sh"; bench_fixture_setup; cd work; export FACTORY_BENCH_DIR="$PWD/../benches"; mkdir -p .agentic; echo '{"bench":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; bench_fixture_spec . pr-open feature 001; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/bench.sh"; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; bench_reconcile; echo '# plan' > "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/TEST-PLAN.md"; tracker_advance factory/specs/001-t.md done; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; ONLY_PLAN=$([ -d "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" ] && echo yes || echo no); tracker_advance factory/specs/001-t.md pr-open; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; echo '# plan' > "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/TEST-PLAN.md"; echo notes > "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature/NOTES.txt"; tracker_advance factory/specs/001-t.md done; bench_reconcile 2>/dev/null; WITH_WORK=$([ -d "$FACTORY_BENCH_DIR/feature" ] && echo yes || echo no); jq -n --arg a "$ONLY_PLAN" --arg b "$WITH_WORK" '{bench_after_plan_only: $a, bench_after_user_work: $b}'
_note: the review stage drops TEST-PLAN.md into the bench for hands-on testing. If bench_remove counted it as user work, EVERY bench would become permanently undeletable and the reconcile loop would silently stop cleaning up. Guards both halves: a bench holding only TEST-PLAN.md is removable; one also holding real user edits is still protected. Uses the shared bench-repo fixture — an earlier hand-rolled version created its bare remote at ../rem.git, OUTSIDE the per-case sandbox, and collided across runs.
